text:
Nina Chen: Quick sync — we need final owners for route-level compatibility for the v2 rollout. Specifically: header-based negotiation (`X-Redwood-ApiVersion`), graceful fallback to v1, and canary routing. Who owns routing/envoy config vs SDK header behavior? I'm assembling the cutover checklist; please drop blockers/PRs.

Amit Rao: I'll take routing + envoy changes. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821. Includes header match + fallback rules. Needs eng-infra review. Sample match we plan to use:
```yaml
- match:
    headers:
      - name: X-Redwood-ApiVersion
        exact: v2
  route: v2-pool
```
Will request canary slot once reviewers sign off.

Sam Ortega: SDK side — I'll add header negotiation and a client-side fallback (SDK v1.4.0). PR #4830 in client-sdk. Behavior: if server responds 426 + `X-Redwood-Force-Version`, SDK will retry with that version. Adding unit + e2e tests.

Priya Patel: Infra note: router-config push depends on INF-210 (cust-router rollout). Need maintenance window for config push and edge cert reload. Prefer Tue 09:00 PT to avoid peak traffic. Also: confirm N+1 proxies in the v2 pool before enabling.

Li Wei: Telemetry/alerts: ensure every routed request emits `api_version` and `route` tags. I'll add a smoke eval that checks latency delta and error rate for v2 canary. Suggest alert if 500s on v2 > 0.5% over 5m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: canary-42. Window: 2026-03-21T09:00Z -> 2026-03-21T12:00Z. Use `canary-42` for routing header tests.

Nina Chen: Summarizing owners: Amit (routing), Sam (SDK), Priya (infra rollout), Li (telemetry). Can each of you drop final PR links + the remaining checklist items here? I'll compile and post to #eng-platform and ping @eng-sre for canary watch. :mag:

Amit Rao: Added checklist to PR 4821: config doc, envoy patch, integration test matrix, rollback play. Marking eng-infra reviewers @Priya.

Sam Ortega: PR 4830 includes SDK fallback test and matrix for node/python/java. Will request Alex for code review. cc @Alex Kim

Priya Patel: INF-210 filed and maintenance window requested. Linking infra runbook excerpt: https://internal.redwood.io/runbooks/router-config. Need approval for cert reload steps.

Li Wei: Dashboards updated in Grafana under "API Rollouts / v2". ETA for smoke evals & alerts: EOD Mon. Will add alert configs to ops-runbooks.

Nina Chen: Great — if there are no major blockers, I'll schedule the cutover and open the canary run play. Please drop anything else by EOD. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: Quick note — I'll prioritize the SDK CR review first thing tomorrow.

Nina Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll post the compiled checklist and timeline in #eng-platform shortly.
